what_was_done: Refactored LangGraph pipeline in graph.py to use an Agent Loop.
Created agent.py to handle ReAct and Tool Calling logic using CEO model.
Created tool_executor.py to map agent tool calls to existing pipeline functions.
Added agent_tool_call and agent_iterations to PipelineState in contracts.py.
evidence: ruff check passed. The pipeline now routes dynamically between agent and tool_executor instead of using a static DAG.
risks: The UI relies on SSE events which might arrive in a slightly different sequence if the agent skips some tools. However, node wrappers maintain the standard event types.
Local model (Qwen) might fail to follow the strict JSON formatting for ReAct tool calls.
next_step: Run tests and verify the UI behavior with a real message to the backend.
